Final for Publication

23021-T1

Substitute Type-1 Narrative and Plans
For 2428 N. Clybourn Avenue

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,957 SF — Irregular lot shape

Proposed use: The applicant plans to develop this zoning lot and build a new 4-story building
containing three (3) dwelling units and zero parking spaces.

A. Floor area ratio: 5,027 SF — 1.7 FAR.
B. Density: 2,957 SF + 3 DU = 985 SF per DU.
C. Off-street parking: zero parking spaces.

D. Setbacks: Existing
Front setback — None
North side setback — 2.0 feet
South setback — 3.0 feet
Rear setback — 16’-2”

E. Building height: 38 feet.

Seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached
plans. More specifically, per section 17-13-0303-D, the applicant seeks the following
administrative adjustments and variations:

1. Per section 17-13-1003-I other setbacks, applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to
reduce the minimum required rear setback from 33.12’ to 16’-2”. The parcel is
landlocked with no alley access. It also has an irregular shape because it fronts on
Clybourn. Unique because of both no alley access and irregular shape.

2. Per section 17-10-0102-B transit served locations, in this RM-4.5 district, the minimum
off-street parking ratio is reduced by 100% to zero parking spaces for this transit served
location. (Ashland Avenue bus corridor and Fullerton Avenue bus corridor).
